The '''Baxel Sector Fleet''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] assigned to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sarn Shild]] of the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fleet was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Winstel Greelanx]] and was mostly composed of older Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The fleet was defeated by a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] fleet led by [[Mako Spince]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] at the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].
